en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large brick fire station with arched windows. Several open bays reveal horse-drawn fire wagons lined up in front, with uniformed firefighters standing beside or seated on the wagons. A leafy tree frames the left side. Printed captions in Swedish appear in red and black, including a city name and a phrase about the fire brigade heading out.
